instruction: In django/utils/http.py, int_to_base36 builds its result by prepending to a string. Collect the digits in a list instead: write "b36_parts = []" in place of the line 'b36 = ""', then in place of the two lines that end the loop body and the function ("b36 = char_set[n] + b36" and "return b36") write "b36_parts.append(char_set[n])" in the loop and 'return "".join(reversed(b36_parts))' after it.
